description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for translation functionality within the Daux documentation generator project. It defines a test class 'TranslateTest' that verifies translation of UI strings across different languages using a virtual file system and a template engine.

classes.name: TranslateTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing translation functionalities within the Daux documentation generator.

methods.name: getTree
methods.description: Sets up a virtual directory structure with English and Italian pages and builds a documentation tree for testing.

methods.name: translateDataProvider
methods.description: Provides sample translation pairs for testing translation functionality.

methods.name: testTranslate
methods.description: Runs a test to verify that the translation of the 'Link_previous' string matches expected output for a given language.
